_why._note: JSON allows no comments and the validator reads only 'suppress', so the reason for each entry lives here, keyed by the exact entry. Add a reason whenever you add a suppression.
_why.Terminology_TX_NoValid_16@Implementation: The IG Publisher's own parameter codes (copyrightyear, path-data, special-url, ...) are required by the publisher but are not in the R4 guide-parameter-code value set.
_why.UNABLE_TO_INFER_CODESYSTEM@Implementatio: Same IG Publisher parameter codes as above; validator 6.10.4 reports them under this message id instead.
_why.MSG_DRAFT: The module is in ballot and references draft ValueSets and CodeSystems (its own and its dependencies'); these warnings go away once the referenced artifacts are published as active.
_why.TERMINOLOGY_TX_WARNING@StructureDefiniti: Terminology server notes on codes inside profile definitions (patterns and bindings, e.g. edition or version differences); the same codes are still checked on every instance.
_why.http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/: SUSHI output has no narrative; the IG Publisher generates the narrative during the build, so the published resources do have one.
The ICU logical model deliberately keeps UpperCamelCase element names (MonitoringUndVitaldaten, ParameterCode, ...), which eld-20 rejects for every path segment after the root.
_why.UNABLE_TO_INFER_CODESYSTEM@StructureDefi: Codes given without a system in profile patterns or bindings that draw on several code systems cannot be tied to one system when the profile itself is checked; instances carry the system and are validated normally.
_why.Terminology_TX_NoValid_16@StructureDefin: Codes fixed in profiles are checked against value sets the terminology server cannot fully expand at profile level; instances are still validated against the binding.
_why.VALUESET_INCLUDE_INVALID_CONCEPT_CODE@Va: Some value sets list codes from code system releases the terminology server does not have yet. Broad: it can also hide real invalid codes, so check new value set codes with $lookup.
_why.UNKNOWN_CODESYSTEM@CapabilityStatement.j: urn:iso:std:iso:3166#DE is the correct jurisdiction, but the terminology server (SU-TermServ) has no definition of the ISO 3166 code system.
_why.UNKNOWN_CODESYSTEM@ImplementationGuide.j: Same ISO 3166 jurisdiction coding as above, on the ImplementationGuide.
